item.title: PMH Rodent Response, Gun Trafficking, Tourism Record
item.ns0:title: PMH Rodent Response, Gun Trafficking, Tourism Record
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, health officials apologize and take corrective action after a viral video reveals a rodent roaming inside the Princess Margaret Hospital. We dive into the latest statistics on illegal gun trafficking as regional stakeholders meet in Nassau to combat gun violence, and we bring you the emotional homecoming of a family of eight displaced by a devastating fire three years ago. Our team also takes you to Abaco where young students are getting hands-on experience with coding and 3D printing, and we celebrate a historic sports milestone as Bahamian surfers head to the world stage for the first time. Be sure to watch the full broadcast to stay informed on these stories, plus get your complete weekend sports and weather forecast.
